data.text: His foundation is in the holy mountains.
data.subtitulo: Of the sons of Korah. A psalm. A song.

data.text: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
Glorious things are spoken of you, city of God. Selah.
“I will name Rahab and Babylon among those who know me. Look, Philistia and Tyre, with Cush: ‘This one was born there.’”
Of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one were born in her,” and the Most High himself will establish her.
The LORD will count as he registers the peoples, “This one was born there.” Selah.
Singers and flute players alike will say, “All my springs are in you.”
data.titulo: All My Springs Are in You
